passages.chapter_path: 1 INTRODUCTION / 1.1 Purpose
passages.quote_original: The purpose of this procedure is to describe methods for software installation, keeping, handling and maintenance. This procedure applies to all software used for performing activities described in ENCONET Quality Assurance Program. This procedure affects personnel involved in the software installation keeping, handling and maintenance.

passages.chapter_path: 1 INTRODUCTION / 1.2 Scope
passages.quote_original: This procedure gives instructions for software installation, storage control and control of physical media, and software maintenance dependable upon the form of the software available in ENCONET d.o.o.

passages.quote_original: | QA           | Quality Assurance   |

passages.chapter_path: 2 ABBREVIATIONS AND DEFINITIONS / 2.2 Definitions
passages.quote_original: 1. Software Installation – The process of restoring software from external media to a local file system and preparation of conditions to be used on PC/workstation.

passages.chapter_path: 2 ABBREVIATIONS AND DEFINITIONS / 2.2 Definitions
passages.quote_original: 2. Control of the physical media and associated services – all functions, which are carried out to ensure that the data or software stored, are physically retrievable and cannot be lost or compromised due to any day to day operations or possible catastrophic events.

passages.chapter_path: 2 ABBREVIATIONS AND DEFINITIONS / 2.2 Definitions
passages.quote_original: 3. Software Maintenance – the process of modifying a software system or component, after delivery, to correct faults, improve performance or other attributes, adapt to a changed environment, or add new functionality.

passages.chapter_path: 2 ABBREVIATIONS AND DEFINITIONS / 2.2 Definitions
passages.quote_original: 4. Software Maintenance Documentation – provides information on how to support the software during its operational life.

passages.chapter_path: 2 ABBREVIATIONS AND DEFINITIONS / 2.2 Definitions
passages.quote_original: 5. Test Case – a specific set of test data and associated procedures developed for particular objective.

passages.quote_original: 4.3 Software maintenance

passages.chapter_path: 4 INSTRUCTIONS / 4.2 Storage control and control of physical media
passages.quote_original:
4.3.1 The software maintenance process is dependable upon the form of the
      software available in ENCONET d.o.o.

passages.chapter_path: 4 INSTRUCTIONS / 4.2 Storage control and control of physical media
passages.quote_original:
4.3.1.1 Software available only in the form of executable shall be
            maintained to assure that the version is compatible with the
            verified environment (operating system version and hardware).

passages.chapter_path: 4 INSTRUCTIONS / 4.2 Storage control and control of physical media
passages.quote_original:
4.3.1.2 Software available in the form of the source code or precompiled
            routines and libraries shall be maintained for the same conditions
            as 4.3.1.1 with addition of checking of compatibility with compiler
            or other supporting programming tools.
